main.summary: Coordinates smooth asynchronous pacing for a shared byte-per-second budget.

field.name: NextAvailableTimestamp
field.summary: The monotonic timestamp at which the next byte reservation may finish.

field.name: BytesPerSecond
field.summary: The maximum number of bytes paced per second.

field.name: Gate
field.summary: Serializes pacing-slot reservations made against this shared budget.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.param: The positive maximum number of bytes paced per second.

method.name: WaitAsync
method.summary: Reserves a pacing slot for the specified byte count and asynchronously waits for that slot to complete.
method.param: The non-negative number of bytes to account for.
A token used to cancel reservation or the wait. Cancellation after reservation does not reclaim the reserved time slot.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes when the byte count has been paced.
